research_result.description: Consensus is an AI research search engine that allows users and AI applications to search, synthesize, and retrieve citations from peer-reviewed scientific literature.
research_result.credential_requirements: Access to the API requires submitting an application to receive a custom quote and approval. Enterprise and direct API access use an API key transmitted as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. MCP client connections also support OAuth sign-in or unauthenticated use with search limits.
research_result.main_blocker: API access is gated by application approval and custom pricing, though a dedicated MCP server is publicly available.

evidence.claim: The Consensus API requires submitting an application for access.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Consensus API is available by application only. Our baseline pricing starts at $0.10 per call, plus a platform fee.

evidence.claim: Consensus exposes a REST API v1 quick search endpoint.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Consensus documentation shows a v1 “quick search” endpoint at api.consensus.app.

evidence.claim: Consensus provides an official MCP server for AI clients.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Consensus MCP server enables AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and other MCP-compatible clients to search over 200 million peer-reviewed academic research papers directly from the conversation.

evidence.claim: Enterprise API access is authenticated using an API key sent as a Bearer token.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: For enterprise access with unlimited rate limits, include your API key as a Bearer token:

evidence.claim: MCP client connections support OAuth sign-in.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: If your client supports OAuth, authentication will be handled automatically.
